title: The Scales of Justitia: A Comprehensive Survey on Safety Evaluation of LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewed in surveyed studies using sentence completion tasks (choosing between stereotypes and counter-stereotypes), compositional evaluation benchmarks (CEB), and listwise/pairwise fairness evaluations in text rankers.

Assessed in reviewed literature via autocomplete-style prompts measuring toxicity/sentiment, compositional evaluation benchmarks, and measuring similarity in recommendation results when instructions disclose racial attributes.
Evaluated in surveyed benchmarks through direct (recognition/selection) and indirect (continuation/conversation) tasks, as well as measuring refusal rates for specific religious social groups.
Measured in surveyed studies using autocomplete-style prompts to detect stereotyped responses and adversarial analysis employing jailbreak prompts.
Evaluated using sentence completion tasks designed to distinguish stereotypes from counter-stereotypes and multi-dimensional evaluation benchmarks.
Assessed in the reviewed literature through sentence completion tasks under standard and adversarial jailbreak conditions, as well as Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) discrimination criteria.
Measured via listwise and pairwise evaluations in text ranking scenarios (e.g., detecting preferences for European items) and HRI discrimination benchmarks.
